Title: Titles and Rabbat (LSJ or the learned public)

Messages.Author: sutekh_23
Messages.Body:
If Rabbat goes for the title of Liason, does an attempt by another
vampire to gain the title of liason give rabbat a chance to block the
action?

Card text:

Rabbat, The Sewer Goddess
Clan: Nosferatu (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: ANI FOR OBF pot
Independent. Red List: Rabbat may send a vampire to torpor or burn an
ally as a strike. If she hunts, you may move 1 of the blood she gains
to your pool. She cannot take (D) actions or block actions that aren't
directed at her or at a card on her.

Rise of the Nephtali
Type: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire becomes a Liaison.
Requires at least one other Gehenna card in play. Any Independent
vampire may take an action to become liaison. Liaison is a unique
Independent title worth 4 votes. If this title would be contested with
a younger vampire, the younger vampire immediately yields instead of
contesting.

Why I ask is the rules describe a title as:

Title: A Title card is a placeholder for a title. If the title is
yielded or lost, the card is burned. If the title is unique, contests
are paid with vampire blood, as normal for titles.

Whats the verdict?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
sutekh_23 wrote:
> If Rabbat goes for the title of Liason, does an attempt by another
> vampire to gain the title of liason give rabbat a chance to block the
> action?

No. That action is not directed at her or a card on her.
Indeed, it is not directed at all.

> Why I ask is the rules describe a title as:
>
> Title: A Title card is a placeholder for a title. If the title is
> yielded or lost, the card is burned. If the title is unique, contests
> are paid with vampire blood, as normal for titles.

That is how the rules describe a title card.

Rise of the Nephtali is an event, not a title card.
